en.headline: ICAC charges former HKEX vice-president over asset declaration failure
en.dek: Geoffrey Tong Po-hang, 39, faces one count of failing to comply with a Prevention of Bribery Ordinance notice; he is due to plead at Eastern Magistrates’ Courts on Friday.
body: The Independent Commission Against Corruption has charged a former vice-president of Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing with failing to submit a required statutory declaration of his assets during an ongoing corruption investigation.

Geoffrey Tong Po-hang, 39, faces one count of failing to comply with a notice issued under section 14(1) of the Prevention of Bribery Ordinance. ICAC officers served the notice in late September 2025 requiring him to declare property, expenditures and liabilities over the preceding three years. An extension was granted to 12 March 2026 at his request.

Prosecutors allege that without reasonable excuse he failed to provide information on 30 cash deposits totalling more than HK$2.1 million made to his bank account. Tong was released on bail and is scheduled to enter a plea at Eastern Magistrates’ Courts on Friday.

zh.headline: 廉政公署起訴港交所前副總裁 涉未按要求申報資產
zh.dek: 39歲湯寶衡被控一項不遵從《防止賄賂條例》通知書要求罪，周五於東區裁判法院答辯。
body: 廉政公署起訴一名香港交易及結算所有限公司前副總裁，指他在一宗進行中的貪污調查中，未有按要求提交法定資產聲明。
湯寶衡，39歲，被控一項不遵從《防止賄賂條例》第14(1)條通知書要求罪。廉署人員於2025年9月下旬向他送達通知書，要求申報過去三年的財產、開支及負債。應其要求，期限延至2026年3月12日。
控方指他在沒有合理辯解下，未有提供共30筆存入銀行帳戶、總額逾210萬港元現金存款的資料。湯寶衡已獲准保釋，定於周五在東區裁判法院答辯。
